definition_en: The SocialOS service that exposes tools to agents over MCP.
note: MCP is never translated.

definition_en: A named credential plus client config that lets one agent use SocialOS.
note: The record in Developer → MCP connections. The client itself is the "agent".

definition_en: An AI client (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor…) that acts in SocialOS through MCP or the API.
note: Not "bot", "assistant" or "AI". Always name the agent when it acted.

definition_en: One operation an agent can call, such as create_draft.
note: Tool names (publish_post) are code and never translated.

definition_en: A secret (sk_live_…) that lets a script or agent act as the user within its scopes. Shown once.
note: "API" stays Latin; "key" is translated (style guide §14).

definition_en: One permission on a key, such as posts:publish.
note: Developer screens only; elsewhere say "permission". Scope ids are code. kk: confirm.

definition_en: What a key or agent is allowed to do, in plain words.
Read-only or reversible actions. On by default.
note: One set of risk levels everywhere: UI shows Safe/Medium/Dangerous, MCP safe/low/medium/sensitive/critical, backend safe/sensitive/critical. Use safe/sensitive/critical.

definition_en: Public or hard-to-undo actions (publish, delete). Off by default; needs confirmation.
note: Owner decision pending: posts:schedule is safe in the backend but medium in UI and MCP.

definition_en: Actions that remove access or credentials (disconnect). Off by default; needs confirmation.
A URL that accepts posts (Discord, Slack). Anyone holding it can post.
note: Do not translate. Copy treats it as a secret.

definition_en: A credential issued by a network, stored encrypted.
note: Never shown after connect.

definition_en: Content (text and media) that SocialOS publishes to one or more accounts.
note: es is feminine (statuses agree: Publicada). pt-BR is masculine (o post). kk: confirm жазба vs пост.

definition_en: A post that is neither scheduled nor published.
note: kk: confirm (Gmail kk is believed to use нобай).

definition_en: The page where a new post is written.
note: Nav label. The button is "Write a post".

definition_en: The words of a post. The main text goes to every account that has no custom text.
note: Replaces "content" and "universal content" in UI.

definition_en: Text that replaces the main text for one account.
Optional internal name of a post. Not published today.
note: Dev.to requires a published title. Update the hint when Dev.to ships.

definition_en: Set a future time for SocialOS to publish a post automatically.
note: ja button: 予約投稿.

definition_en: Will publish automatically at its time.
note: ru and uk statuses use the neuter impersonal form, so they need no gender agreement.

definition_en: Send a post to its accounts on the networks.
note: ja: 投稿, not 公開.

definition_en: Publish immediately. Sensitive; needs confirmation.
Being sent to the networks right now.
Every account confirmed the post.
Some accounts published it; others failed.
No account could publish the post.
Stopped for good. It will never publish.
note: US spelling in UI. The API status stays cancelled. kk: confirm.

definition_en: Stop a draft or scheduled post for good.
note: A separate key from the dialog's Cancel. Its dismiss button is "Keep post".

definition_en: Close a dialog without doing anything.
Publish again to the accounts where publishing failed.
note: Never used for reloading data.

definition_en: Reload data after a failed load.
note: A separate key from retry.

definition_en: SocialOS cannot tell whether the post went out. Check the network before retrying, or it may post twice.
note: API status needs_review. Replaces "Needs review" so it never reads as approval.

definition_en: One try to publish a post to one account.
A profile, page or channel on a network that is connected to SocialOS.
note: Write "SocialOS account" for the user's own sign-in. uk follows Google and Mastodon.

definition_en: A social network SocialOS can publish to, such as LinkedIn or Telegram.
note: UI term. "provider" stays in the API and code. Never "platform".

definition_en: Link an account to SocialOS (sign-in, a one-time code or a token).
Connect an account again after its access stopped working.
The account's access no longer works. Posts to it fail until it is reconnected.
note: API status expired. Replaces "Expired" for accounts.

definition_en: Remove an account and its stored credentials from SocialOS.
note: Critical; needs confirmation.

definition_en: A key that is past its expiry date.
note: Keys only. Accounts use "needs reconnecting".

definition_en: Permanently stop a key or MCP connection from working.
note: kk: confirm.

definition_en: What a network supports through SocialOS: text, images, video, delete, analytics and limits.
The most characters a network accepts in one post.
Images and videos uploaded to SocialOS.
All files the user uploaded, reusable across posts.
Send a file from the device to SocialOS.
note: ru: download is скачать. uk uses завантажити for both directions, so name the direction where it is ambiguous (на сервер / на пристрій).

definition_en: Add uploaded media to a post.
How a post will look on each network.
Posts laid out by date in the user's time zone.
The overview page: what is going out and what needs attention.
Metrics that networks report about published posts.
The zone used to enter and show times.
note: Two words in English.

definition_en: Profile, preferences and security.
The record of every action by people and agents, with the actor and the time.
How many requests each API key and MCP connection made.
(planned) How much a user may do per period, such as posts per day.
note: Per-user quotas are on the roadmap. Not in the UI yet.

definition_en: A cap on requests per time window. Going over it returns "Too many requests".
(planned) A shared space where a team manages accounts and posts.
note: Not in the product yet; SocialOS is single-user today.

definition_en: (planned) A person's explicit yes to an agent's sensitive action, checked by the server.
note: Not the same as confirm. Do not use in UI until server-side approval ships.

definition_en: (planned) Give approval to an agent's pending action.
note: The opposite button is Reject: Отклонить, Қабылдамау, Відхилити, Rechazar, Recusar, Ablehnen, 却下する.

definition_en: Say yes in a dialog, or send confirm: true from an agent.
note: The confirm flag is set by the agent; the server cannot verify that a person agreed.

definition_en: Enter SocialOS with email and password.
note: Not "log in" or "login".

definition_en: End the current session.
Register a SocialOS account.
note: Replaces "Register" and "registered".

definition_en: Prove you own the email address with a one-time link.
ja: メールアドレスを確認
note: One verb in subject, body and button (not "confirm" in one place and "verify" in another).

definition_en: Choosing a new password through a one-time email link.
A downloadable copy of all the user's data.
ja: データのエクスポート

definition_en: Remove from SocialOS. Published copies stay on the networks.
note: Always say what stays (the published copies).

definition_en: A Telegram channel or group that SocialOS posts to.
A short code the user posts in a Telegram chat to prove they control it. Works once, for 15 minutes.
The person who runs this SocialOS server (it is self-hosted).
note: Replaces "operator of this server" in emails.

definition_en: The built-in mock network for tests and the demo. It posts nowhere.
ja: テスト用ネットワーク
note: Replaces "Mock" in UI. Refused in production.

definition_en: Installed and run on your own server.
